$comment: REFERENCE ONLY — not a real comp, not indexed. Lives in BSRData/Examples/ so
GenerateTeamIndex.mjs (which only reads BSRData/Teams/<group>/*.json) never picks it up.
This shows how to give one comp a rotation per button in the Team Builder's
"What would you like to optimize for?" picker. Copy the shapes below into a real
team file at BSRData/Teams/<group>/<team-id>.json, then run:
node BSRData/GenerateTeamIndex.mjs
See BSRData/Examples/README.md for the full field-by-field walkthrough.
name: Example Team

$comment: ONE BUTTON = ONE ENTRY IN THIS ARRAY.
`goal` decides which button reveals it. Valid goals, in the order they render:
general | coop-boss | events | frenzy-feast
A rotation with no `goal` is treated as "general".
A button with no entry here renders greyed out and unclickable, so you only
get a live button once you have actually written the rotation behind it.
p2w-rotations.name: Example Team
steps: Plain-text fallback, one line per phase. Shown when icons can't resolve.
Kenpachi Technique → Mayuri Ultimate → White Special Attack → Kenpachi Counter

$comment: `slug` is who leads the step — must be a member above (or one of their
`swappable` alternatives). `actions` is the chain they perform.
`kind` resolves that character's real skill icon. Kinds every character has:
Basic Attack | Technique | Ultimate | Counter | Dodge | Swap | Repeat
Also accepted: BFS (Battlefield Skill), SpcAtk (Special Attack), Cancel,
an "Enhanced " prefix on any kind (orange border), and a trailing number
for extra icon variants ("Technique 2", "Ultimate 2").
`label` is the small text under the chip, e.g. "x3".
`kind: "Swap"` takes its own `slug` — the character being swapped TO.

iconSteps.$comment: End on Repeat so the rotation reads as a loop rather than stopping dead.

p2w-rotations.notes: What this route is for and when to pick it.

$comment: CO-OP BOSSES — the one NESTED button. Clicking it opens a second row, and
each entry with goal "coop-boss" becomes one boss button in that row.
`boss` says WHICH button reaches this rotation. Valid ids (rename labels in
Web/Source/Lib/RotationGoals.ts -> BOSS_CATALOG):
ranuganga | yammy-llargo | sajin-komamura | ashisougi-jizo
`boss` is REQUIRED on coop-boss entries and FORBIDDEN on every other goal —
GenerateTeamIndex.mjs fails the build if you get that wrong.
Add one entry per boss you have a rotation for; the rest stay greyed.
p2w-rotations.name: Example Team — Ranuganga
$comment2: `note` is the quiet centred footnote under the rotation, matching the one on
character pages. Use it for caveats ABOUT this entry — where it came from, what
it assumes, what is still unconfirmed — not for instructions (that is `notes`).
It is per BUTTON, so each goal and each boss can carry its own.
Every rotation in the real data ships with "note": "" — blank renders nothing.
p2w-rotations.note: Verified at B6W5C5 against the 2026-07 balance pass.
steps: Short fight — one buffed window is the whole rotation.
p2w-rotations.notes: Nothing held in reserve — this tier should die inside the first window.

p2w-rotations.$comment: A second boss button. Same shape, different `boss` id.
p2w-rotations.name: Example Team — Sajin Komamura
steps: Counter windows over greed — a death costs more than the damage.
p2w-rotations.notes: Slower than the General route, but it survives the phase transitions.

$comment: LINEUP VARIANTS stack on top of goals. `lineup` lists the slugs this
version assumes are active — only the slots that DIFFER from `members`.
The UI narrows to the chosen goal first, then picks the lineup variant
inside it, so this is the Events rotation *when Rangiku replaces Mayuri*.
Without `lineup`, an entry is the default for its goal.
p2w-rotations.name: Example Team — Events (Rangiku)
steps: Long stage, no reset — hold the loop and bank Ultimates.
p2w-rotations.notes: Bank the Ultimate for whatever damage window the stage gives you.

$comment: `unverified: true` marks a rotation you have written but NOT play-tested.
The button greys out and locks exactly as if it were missing, and an
"Unverified" chip shows next to the rotation name. Delete the flag once
you have actually run it and the button goes live.
p2w-rotations.name: Example Team — Frenzy Feast
steps: Draft — buffs first, then everything Kenpachi has in one pass.

$comment: The two lists are INDEPENDENT — the P2W/F2P toggle swaps between them, and
the goal buttons are rebuilt from whichever list is showing. So a goal that
exists only under p2w-rotations is lit on P2W and greyed on F2P.
Give a goal an entry in BOTH lists to have it live on both routes.
F2P versions usually drop the "Enhanced " prefixes, since that tier isn't available.
f2p-rotations.name: Example Team
f2p-rotations.notes: Lower boundary charges Spiritual Pressure slower — expect one Ultimate, not two.

f2p-rotations.$comment: Only Ranuganga is written for F2P here, so on the F2P route the other three bosses stay greyed.
f2p-rotations.name: Example Team — Ranuganga
steps: One buffed pass is enough at this tier.
